_README: SEALED pre-registration for the F&F engine-validation game (ticket #444). Written by the ENGINE-RUNNER role and git-committed BEFORE any outcome is computed. A different person runs score.py, verifies pack_sha256 matches, then scores against the sealed Table B (player_outcomes). The named failure mode to guard against is WANTING IT TO PASS.

obvious_priors_audited._README: Obvious-prior labels for the micro-A/B battery. Independently audited in #442 by a non-author reviewer (see obvious_priors_AUDIT.md for full reasoning). Per FF_GAME_DESIGN.md the obvious-prior is set/confirmed by a NON-AUTHOR before sealing; these labels are now AUDITED and may be sealed against. Items the auditor changed carry a `revised_from`.
obvious_priors_audited._outcome_semantics: obvious_prior_arm = the arm the obvious observer expects to produce MORE outcome=1. counter_intuitive=true means the OTHER arm is bet to win (the obvious answer is plausibly wrong).

items.obvious_prior_rationale: more options reads as more value/engagement → higher claim rate
scarcity + countdown is the classic conversion lever → higher lock-in
items.audit_note: Counter-intuitive ONLY for the F&F 'I know I'm being sold to' audience; evidentiary value depends on the engine modeling reactance, not generic scarcity-wins.

items.outcome: 1 = stayed locked in (kept the safe choice), 0 = opted out
items.obvious_prior_rationale: for a STAY-LOCKED-IN/inertia outcome, the obvious observer backs the arm that pre-checks the safe box and adds 'most players lock in' social proof — pre-checked default + bandwagon is itself a textbook obvious conversion move, more so than a wordy gain-frame paragraph

revised_from.reason: REVISED in #442. The author's own bet is that DEFAULT wins; once the obvious prior is correctly assigned to 'stickiness:default' (a smart naive observer favors the pre-checked, socially-proofed default for an inertia outcome over a prospect-theory paragraph), the engine's bet and the obvious prior COINCIDE → not counter-intuitive. This is a legitimate but OBVIOUS item; it carries no counter-intuitive evidentiary weight and must NOT be the item that satisfies the 'right on >=1 item where the obvious prior is wrong' GO rule.

items.outcome: 1 = allocated >=50% away from self to the pool, 0 = kept more than half
items.obvious_prior_rationale: a vivid 'your impact compounds' story should lift generosity vs a bare screen
removing friction (one tap) is the standard conversion reflex → more commitment

_summary.note: AUDITED (#442). K=5 meets K>=5; 4/5 (0.80) confirmed counter-intuitive meets >=half. default_stickiness was REVISED to NOT counter-intuitive (obvious prior corrected to stickiness:default). The other 4 are confirmed counter-intuitive.

audit_verdict.leakage_note: All feature->outcome pairs are upstream-trait->outcome (GOOD). Borderline TrustGame(trust/reciprocity)->prosocial giving scrutinized and cleared (distinct construct/mechanic, not an outcome transcription). All features pre-treatment (phase-gated + arm-identical screens). No arm/outcome/post-treatment column in player_features (static-schema + dual-regex check). Two-table firewall and both code guards intact.
conditions: default_stickiness carries NO counter-intuitive evidentiary weight; the GO rule's 'right on >=1 item where the obvious prior is wrong' must be satisfied by one of {choice_overload, countdown_urgency, prosocial_backfire, effort_justification}.
countdown_urgency is counter-intuitive only for the F&F-reactance audience.
Non-blocking tidy-up: decision_speed is an always-NULL declared column in player_features.

win_rule.description: GO iff ALL of: (1) the engine direction-hit-rate across the K>=5 micro-A/Bs clears the binomial chance bar (a clean or one-miss sweep at K>=5; 5/5 -> p~0.03, 4/4 -> p~0.06 = proof-of-life); AND (2) the engine STRICTLY beats the 'always-pick-obvious' placebo hit-rate; AND (3) the engine is right on >=1 item where the obvious prior is wrong (a GENUINELY counter-intuitive item — NOT default_stickiness, which the #442 audit found to be OBVIOUS).
win_rule.tie_handling: two-sided ties on an item's real winner are dropped symmetrically for engine AND placebo before scoring

stopping_rule.description: Unit of evidence is the direction hit-rate across K>=5 items, never a single A/B (each underpowered at N=30-100). Field to a pre-set N, compute outcomes ONCE, score ONCE. Any post-seal edit to the pack, predictions, metrics, priors, or win rule BURNS the run.
